1.why: Body text uses a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height, although the small monospace log lines are tighter and less generous.

2.why: Instructions contain no italics and no dense paragraphs, and the only all-caps text is the 'YOUR ONLINE BANK' brand label rather than guidance.

3.why: The narrow single-column card layout with large text and full-width fields should reflow cleanly at phone width, though the screenshots only show a desktop rendering.

4.why: Every instruction is a single short plain-language sentence, e.g. 'Set up an extra check for protected payments.'

5.why: No field shows a placeholder or worked example of the expected input; the only format cue is the simulated value printed in the Logs panel.

6.why: The user only ever reads short labels and one-line log entries, and even the accumulated log stays a few lines rather than a long block.

7.why: The manual secret, identity code and verification codes appear only as plain text with no copy button, so the user is expected to retype them by hand.

8.why: Authenticator setup offers only the 'Manual secret' string; no QR code or equivalent alternative appears in any step.

9.why: Fields are standard HTML text inputs that should accept autofill, but nothing on screen demonstrates autocomplete attributes, one-time-code support or password-manager integration.

10.why: Each screen pairs a bold heading with a single prominent blue button (highlighted by an orange focus ring), though no progress indicator shows the step's place in the flow.

11.why: Every screen asks for one main action, the only extra control being the persistent 'Create secure setup code' regeneration button on the setup screen.

12.why: After most actions the app silently advances to the next form, and only the final 'Multi-factor authentication is active' screen plainly states what happened.

13.why: After the error the form remains pre-filled and invites retry, the setup-code button stays available to re-request, and no lockout or penalty is shown.

14.why: The banner 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' avoids blame but neither names the problem nor explains how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown, session timeout or expiry warning appears on any screen, so reading and code entry appear untimed in the observed flow.
